title: First-order smoothed exact-penalty methods for equality-constrained regularized nonconvex optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.19887v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We consider regularized nonconvex optimization over a closed convex set $\mathcal{X} \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$, which involves a convex nonsmooth regularizer $r$ in the objective and $n$ smooth equality constraints. To find a near-KKT point of the problem, we propose a prox-linear first-order method, named as SEPi-Prox, based on a smoothed exact-penalty formulation. At each outer iteration of SEPi-Prox, a strongly convex prox-linear subproblem is formed and solved inexactly to a sufficient accuracy. Under a local non-singularity condition that is weaker than some other commonly used regularity conditions or constraint qualifications, SEPi-Prox finds an $\epsilon$-KKT point within $O(\epsilon^{-2})$ first-order oracle calls, matching the lower bound for unconstrained smooth nonconvex optimization. translated_title: 等式约束正则化非凸优化的一阶光滑精确惩罚方法
translated_abstract: 我们考虑闭凸集 $\mathcal{X} \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ 上的正则化非凸优化问题，其目标函数包含凸非光滑正则项 $r$ 以及 $n$ 个光滑等式约束。为了找到该问题的近似KKT点，我们基于光滑精确惩罚形式提出了一种邻近线性化一阶方法，命名为SEPi-Prox。在SEPi-Prox的每次外层迭代中，会构造一个强凸的邻近线性化子问题，并将其不精确地求解到足够精度。在一个比其他常用正则性条件或约束规范更弱的局部非奇异性条件下，SEPi-Prox能够在 $O(\epsilon^{-2})$ 次一阶oracle调用内找到一个 $\epsilon$-KKT点，这与无约束光滑非凸优化的复杂度下界相匹配。我们采用Nesterov加速邻近梯度法（APG）和对偶割平面法（DCP）来求解这些邻近线性化子问题。
tldr: 提出基于光滑精确惩罚形式的一阶方法SEPi-Prox，在弱于常用约束规范的局部非奇异性条件下，以 $O(\epsilon^{-2})$ 次一阶oracle调用即可找到等式约束正则化非凸优化问题的 $\epsilon$-KKT点，达到无约束光滑非凸优化的理论复杂度下界。
en_tdlr: SEPi-Prox, a first-order method based on a smoothed exact-penalty formulation, finds ε-KKT points of equality-constrained regularized nonconvex optimization within O(ε⁻²) first-order oracle calls under a local non-singularity condition weaker than common constraint qualifications, matching the lower bound for unconstrained smooth nonconvex optimization.
